A two-day interdisciplinary workshop where scientists, philosophers and STS
scholars work through real cases of error in AI-driven modeling, and where the
project's developing framework is presented for feedback. The program will mix
invited talks, discussion sessions and working groups.

We especially welcome early-career researchers, including graduate students,
as participants and presenters, and researchers from sciences beyond climate.

**When and where:** fall 2027, in New York City.

## Call for extended abstracts and speakers

The call for extended abstracts and invitations to speakers goes out in
**February 2027**, with topics, deadlines and how to submit. Want to hear when
the call opens?

## Support for early-career researchers

We aim to offer travel support to some PhD students and early-career
researchers who attend and present. How many we can support, and how to apply,
will be set out in the call.
